description: List all 14 Pauhu sectoral products with their launch state, coverage state, and the current access flag (`entitled`: true|false per row); access does not mean a product is sellable. IMPORTANT: `live_row_count` is a fast estimate of the shared source data, NOT the product's own filtered slice -- read `row_count_basis`/`row_count_note` beside it, and use `corpus_state` and `launch_state` as the coverage signals. A product may be entitled and still not be served yet. Data from this service is sold as the pauhu.eu bulk annual plan; nothing is sold per call here, and cited answers are at https://pauhu.ai. Search is never billed. Customer's AI client calls this once at session start to learn product and access state. Pass product_id for one product's full served row: what one delivered unit is per source (unit_definition), where its rows come from (provenance), its sectoral data space (sectoral_ds), licence, cadence, limitations.

product_id.description: Product id from the list, e.g. pauhu-energy-eu; omit for the list of all products
